typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BUS_FILE_NAME as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string ()
}

source(output(
		hc_id as string,
		gid as string,
		member_id as string,
		member_interface_id as string,
		sent_ind as string,
		do_not_send as string,
		comments as string,
		create_dttm as string,
		interface_type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive({Copy of gid} = toString(gid),
		{Copy of hc_id} = toString(hc_id)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		SBSB_ID_FILE as string,
		GRGR_ID_FILE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SBSB_ID_FILE = {Copy of hc_id},
		GRGR_ID_FILE = {Copy of gid})) ~> OLEDBDestination
